verdict.rationale: A custom-agent builder is a fair question for a work-management SaaS with embedded AI, but the evidence never shows a way to build or configure your own AI agent inside Jira. The closest item is Rovo AI creating custom automations. That is an adjacent automation feature, not a user-configurable agent. The APIs, Marketplace apps and MCP server are developer building blocks or integrations, not an in-product agent builder.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
